integrations.platpricesDescription: The PlatPrices API key is configured via this server's <1>.env</1> file (<3>PLATPRICES_API_KEY</3>), not through the app. Get a key by applying at platprices.com/api-request (usually issued within 1-2 business days), add it to .env, then restart VideoGameTrackarr.
integrations.platpricesRegionCaveat: PlatPrices' free tier lets your account track any 2 PlayStation Store regions at a time (changeable once every 24 hours on platprices.com), plus 1,000 requests/month. Set PLATPRICES_REGION in .env to the two-letter code of one of them (e.g. GB or IN), then recreate the container with docker compose up -d (a plain restart doesn't pick up .env changes). The region in use is shown above, and prices fetched for any other region are cleared on startup.
integrations.platpricesCredit: PlayStation price data is powered by <1>PlatPrices</1>.
